lines.en: label chikachristmalloween2:
scene chikaconfesses1
: Really? So just like that, your parents are back? No explanation? No talk? Just, “Hey, Futaba. We still exist. Here’s your allowance?”
: There was a talk, it was just brief. Apparently, the entire company my father is contracted to was barred from communicating with anyone for the duration of their last project.
: And that included your mom as well? Isn’t that a little...I don’t know...crazy? Like, what the hell does he do? Isn’t he just an architect?
: Mhm. He’s done government jobs before, so I imagine it was something like that. Maybe they’re just a little more strict in America than they are over here?
: That’s so awesome! Because, not to to drag the mood down, but I was really starting to worry that they were just straight up dead.
scene chikaconfesses2
: Thanks for clarifying that you weren’t trying to bring the mood down. Because it sure sounded like you were.
: Damn, Rin. You really just came out and said it?
: What? We were all worried about it.
scene chikaconfesses3
: But now we don’t have to be because we’ve confirmed they’re safe! Do you think they’ll come back to Japan soon? It’s been years since I’ve seen them. I want to hug your mom. She’s soft.
: I think they’re still stuck over there for the time being. You know...on account of the giant wall surrounding Kumon-mi and the ongoing space war.
: Just ask Touka for some help smuggling them back in. Her family practically runs this city, don’t they? I’m sure they can go in and out whenever they want.
: I don’t think they’re in any hurry to get back. And I don’t want to pressure them into thinking they have to for me. I’m just glad they’re safe.
: Well, I’m happy for you, Futaba. And I am also glad your parents aren’t dead.
scene chikaconfesses4
: Me too. Thank you, Otoha.
: I wonder if my biological parents are still alive? I wonder what they’re like if-
: Rin, we need to talk.
scene chikaconfesses5
: Oh, Chika. Hey. Is everything okay?
: How’d your talk with Yumi go? Is Chosoguchi back on?
: Please tell me you didn’t tell her about that.
: Not on purpose.
: It was...fine. Can you just come outside with me? It won’t take long.
: Oh...yeah. Sure.
scene chikaconfesses6
: I’ll...be right back, I guess. I want to hear more about your parents and how alive they are.
scene chikaconfesses7
: Huh...
: Is it me or did that seem kind of serious? Chika’s normally a lot livelier than...whatever that was.
scene chikaconfesses8
: That, Futaba — is how she’s finally going to confess.
scene chikaconfesses9
: What? But Rin already-
scene chikaconfesses10
: Not Rin, dummy. Chika.
: Chika?! But...Chika doesn’t like Rin. Chika’s obsessed with Sensei. That’s like...half of her personality. Why would you think that?
scene chikaconfesses11
: You just start to pick up on things like this when you’ve been around the block as many times as me. I was basically the prince of my last school, remember?
: Besides, why else would Chika always get so possessive around her? Girl’s had it out for me since the moment Rin and I started dating. She’s liked her this whole time. She just didn’t realize it.
: Neither did I...
scene chikaconfesses12
: Hey, that’s not your fault. You were born without gaydar. You’ve gotta leave stuff like this to the experts.
: Otoha...Chika can’t confess to Rin.
scene chikaconfesses13
: What? Why not?
: Because Rin’s finally accepted that she likes Sensei! If Chika confesses to her, she’ll have no idea what to do and start spiraling out of control again! That’s what she does!
: Well, if she likes Sensei, can’t she just turn Chika down?
: You really think Rin is going to turn a girl that attractive down?! Especially one she crushed on for years?!
: Well, what do you suggest we do then? Because Chika and I might be pseudo-enemies, but I’m not about to go get in the way of her shooting her shot.
: Then I will. I can’t let Rin go through that again. Not when she’s always looking out for me and-
scene chikaconfesses14
: Oh, no. You’re not going anywhere either. I am stronger than you and I am keeping you right here.
: But Rin is-

: Rin is a lot stronger now than you probably think. Chika and I made sure of that. And her finally following her heart is all the proof you need that she’s not just some crazy disaster lesbian anymore.
scene chikaconfesses15
: She can handle this. Just trust her, okay?
: I really hope you’re right, Otoha...
: Me too. Because I’ll look like a fucking idiot if I’m not.
scene chikaconfesses16
: Chika, what’s going on? Why did we have to come all the way outside to-
scene chikaconfesses17
: Rin! Just...hold on, okay? Let me do the talking or I’ll just...
: I’ll get distracted and forget everything I wanted to say. And there’s a lot, so...please bear with me. I’ve never done this before.
: Never done what before? What are you doing?
: That’s what I’m trying to get to! Just shut up, okay?! This is hard enough without your reassurance!
scene chikaconfesses18
: I’m sorry, I...I didn’t mean to yell.
: I’m just a little nervous...that’s all.
: This isn’t like when we talk in your room...or my apartment...or in the locker room or at school or any of the million places we talk now that we see each other every day.
: And if that sounded like me complaining, it’s not. I love the time we spend together and I’ve...grown closer to you in the last year than I have with almost anyone I’ve ever met.
scene chikaconfesses19
: I hate myself sometimes, you know. For not talking to you sooner. For missing out on time we could have spent together while we were off doing our own things and...
: And I wonder a lot how we’d be if that never happened. If one of us did approach the other when we were younger.
: I wonder if I’d have stopped bleaching my hair sooner. How different my wardrobe would be and whether or not we’d be sharing clothes.
scene chikaconfesses20

: Because I’d, like...I’d obviously be buying less gyaru stuff if that were the case since you don’t like dressing that way! And I’ve never really had much money to begin with, so...you know. Limited disposable income and...
scene chikaconfesses21
: Wait, no. Fuck. That’s not what I...uhh...I think I’m starting to get off topic. Hold on.
: Can I say something?
: No. Not yet. Not until I’m done. I’m sorry.
scene chikaconfesses22
: Hooh...
: Okay.
scene chikaconfesses23
: Rin — I know I have hurt you in the past. And I know that, right now, you are probably very uncomfortable around me due to certain things that I may have done in your bedroom.
: I don’t regret it. Quite the opposite, actually. And even though we’ve already talked about it, I don’t think I adequately explained myself last time. Especially since we were both naked.
: Chika-
scene chikaconfesses24
: You are way more than just a friend to me! So much so that I feel myself getting crazier and crazier every single day as I force myself to deny it! But I can’t anymore!
: I hate it when other people look at you. I hate it when you look at other people. I hate it that I’m not the center of your world anymore.
: And I hate that I have to hold myself back around you when all I really want to do is drag you into the nearest closet and make you blush so hard that you pass out!
scene chikaconfesses25
: I don’t think I realized how hard I fell for you until you told me you were going to go after Sensei.
: That was the moment I knew. And the first time since I met him that there was someone else I wanted to lock away in a place that no one else could get to.
: I hate it. I hate imagining you with some other person. Even if it’s him. Even if he is the one you love because he is not me.
: And I’m sorry if this is, like...super random and sudden...
: But I think I’m in love with you and if I didn’t admit that tonight, I’d probably just die.
scene chikaconfesses26
: Fuck. Hold on, no. There was more. I skipped a whole part. I should have rehearsed this longer. I should have-
: You’re in love with me?
: Yes! Yes. Madly. Obsessed, even. I legitimately can not stop thinking about you and it is driving me fucking insane.
: And this is...a confession?
: This is me trying to make you understand that anything you are confused about is 100%% my fault.
: And that it isn’t you just getting the wrong idea or not understanding me because no rational person would look at what I’m doing right now and get it. I barely get it.
: You’re sure?...
: You’re sure it’s me?
: Why?
: Why?! Fucking look at you! You’re the cutest fucking thing I’ve ever seen!
: And you’re funny and loyal and reliable and smart and the way you always smell like coffee makes me want to fucking...blend you up and pour you all over my body! Ugh!
: Chika, I...
: I don’t know what to say...
: Never in a million years did I think you’d look at me like this...
: It’s just...a lot to take in...
: Well...
: You can take all the time you need, Rin...
: Because the decision I’ve made is this.
scene chikaconfesses27
: I don’t think we should hang out anymore.
scene chikaconfesses28
: What?...
: At least...
: At least not for a while...
: I don’t get it...
: You’re confessing to me and telling me to go away at the same time?...
: What is that supposed to mean?...How am I supposed to take that?...
scene chikaconfesses29
: Heh...Ridiculous, right?
: A little bit, yeah...
scene chikaconfesses30
: I’m not myself anymore, Rin.
: I’ve fucked things up with Yumi. My relationship with Sensei is going up in flames. Like, shit, I even fell into the yandere archetype at work because I can’t get my fucking head on straight.
: That’s not your fault, of course. It’s mine for not fully understanding myself in the first place.
: I need to get back to normal. I have a little sister to take care of. And a friend who needs my support now more than ever.
: How am I supposed to do any of that if you’re there? I made you the center of my world before you even had a chance to turn me down.
: This isn’t the Chika you fell for back in middle school, right? You said it yourself — that I’ve been acting crazy lately. And I don’t want to be that way anymore. So I think I...
: I think I need to be alone for a little while. Being around you is...
: Well, it’s just too painful.
scene chikaconfesses31
: I’m really sorry, Rin.
: I’ll leave you alone now.
: Don’t fucking move.
scene chikaconfesses32
: Huh?
: I said don’t move. We’re not done here.
: But I-
: I will flash you if I have to. You’re not going anywhere until I have the chance to respond.
scene chikaconfesses33
: What does that do other than make this even harder?! Sensei’s the one you want! I was just a fucking question mark that showed up and made your life all shitty again!
: Who cares if it makes it harder?! You think I don’t know how hard it is to try and be normal around someone you feel that way about?! I did it with you every day for years!
: And yes, Sensei is the one I want right now! But that doesn’t mean you’re not special to me too! Yet here you are, trying to cut me off! What the fuck?!
: I need to, Rin! You don’t understand! I’ll lose sight of everything else if I stay with you!
: Then let me help you!
scene chikaconfesses34
: With what?! Raising a kid?! Helping someone deal with cancer?! Coming to terms with the guy I’ve been seeing for years cheating on me while you actively pursue him?!
: Are you actually ready to help with any of that, Rin?! This is bigger than just a confession! This is my life we’re talking about!
scene chikaconfesses35
: And sometimes, you need to sacrifice something you love if it means protecting everything else.
: What the- how can you say that with a smile?!
: Because I know you’ll be okay...
: And that one day, we’ll be able to talk again without me wanting to keep you all to myself.
: When that happens, I hope I’m closer to the old me than the one I am now.
scene chikaconfesses36
: But even more than that...
: I hope that you’re exactly the same.
: Tell Yumi I said bye, okay?
scene chikaconfesses37
: Please don’t walk away from me.
: I’m sorry, Rin. This, too, is all my fault.
scene chikaconfesses38
: I know where you live! I’ll just come find you!
: Please don’t, Rin...I really need your help with this. Even now, I want to smother you. And so long as I feel that way, I can’t-
scene chikaconfesses39
: Do it...
: Rin-
: Smother me. Smother me if that will keep you from leaving. I love you, Chika.
: But is it the same way I love you?
scene chikaconfesses40
: Don’t go...
: I need to...
: But on the bright side...
scene chikaconfesses27
: I’ll still see you in school!
scene chikaconfesses41
scene black
